decisions.title: RabbitMQ for RPC; Kafka for durable async workflow/events
decisions.decision: Keep transport roles separate by semantics.
decisions.reason: Request/reply and durable pipeline needs differ.
do_not_do: Do not replace both with one transport merely to simplify architecture.
revisit_if: Measured burden outweighs benefit and migration preserves delivery semantics.

decisions.title: Extend existing RAG trace instead of creating a parallel diagnostic trace platform
decisions.decision: Attach retrieval diagnostics to existing RAG trace/checkpoint/eval infrastructure.
decisions.reason: Existing trace IDs/stage instrumentation already provide the execution backbone.
do_not_do: Do not create a separate benchmark-only tracing platform.
revisit_if: Existing trace contract cannot support bounded candidate lineage after a focused spike.

decisions.title: Golden ground truth remains eval-side
decisions.decision: Expected files/chunks/facts never influence live retrieval.
decisions.reason: Otherwise the benchmark contaminates the system being measured.
do_not_do: Do not pass expected labels into production retrieval.

decisions.title: At-least-once plus idempotency over exactly-once claims
decisions.decision: Durable messaging correctness uses explicit replay/idempotency semantics.
do_not_do: Do not describe the Kafka workflow as exactly-once without end-to-end evidence.
revisit_if: A transactional end-to-end design is implemented and chaos-tested.

decisions.title: Self-hosted API token charge is distinct from compute cost
decisions.decision: Report API token charge separately from GPU/compute cost.
decisions.reason: $0 token API charge does not make inference free.
do_not_do: Do not label self-hosted inference cost as simply $0.

decisions.title: Do not add infrastructure for buzzwords alone
decisions.reason: The system already has significant distributed complexity.
do_not_do: Do not add platforms solely for portfolio keywords.
revisit_if: A scoped task demonstrates a concrete requirement and compares alternatives.

decisions.title: OOP is selective, not blanket
decisions.decision: Classes for state/lifecycle/policy/repository/resource ownership; pure metrics/transforms stay functions.
decisions.reason: Classes should encode ownership/invariants, not style theater.
do_not_do: Do not wrap pure Recall/MRR/nDCG calculations in manager classes.

decisions.title: One persistent frontend shell; cache structure, never operational truth
decisions.decision: Every application URL is a page under app/(workspace), whose layout owns the single TabbedPageLayout shell. Chat, Files, Metrics and Eval are retained across tab switches with React <Activity>; every other tab still mounts and unmounts. No Next.js cache boundary or cacheComponents adoption.
decisions.reason: A route that mounts its own shell rebuilds the header and active tab on every transition. <Activity> keeps hand-entered state (filters, drafts, scroll) while still tearing down Effects, so polling stops for a hidden tab. Caching is declined because the app is fully client-rendered behind an auth gate: there is no server-owned stable payload, and every remaining candidate is tenant-scoped or live operational truth.
do_not_do: Do not render TabbedPageLayout from a page; the shell belongs to the layout.
Do not wrap every tab in <Activity> - a hidden subtree costs memory and only pays for itself where mount/unmount destroys operator input.
Do not cache logs, health, metrics, eval runs, ingestion progress or chat streams; do not cache tenant-scoped config to save a request.
revisit_if: A surface becomes server-rendered and genuinely tenant-neutral.
A retained tab is measured to cost meaningful memory.
PRODUCT-01 makes the shell destination URL-driven.

decisions.title: Chat has two surfaces: the answer, and the Developer Inspector
decisions.decision: The default chat answer surface renders answer prose, document-level sources, a compact quality line and feedback - nothing else. Every identifier (review/turn/request/trace/conversation), model slug, raw timestamp, retrieval score, chunk internal, per-node timing, prompt and evaluator payload is rendered only inside DeveloperInspector, which is gated on isAdmin. Quality never prints a coerced 0%: an unmeasured review renders as absent and a no-evidence turn is described as an abstention in words.
decisions.reason: The answer surface was an engineering readout - a large review card, a full-prompt toggle and trace metadata - that buried the answer for the knowledge user it exists for, while the details it exposed were unauthorized for non-admins. Splitting them keeps deep inspection without paying for it on every read, and stating abstention in words avoids reporting a skipped judge as a failing score.
do_not_do: Do not add identifiers, prompts, model slugs, scores or trace fields to MessageBubble or its child components.
Do not render a percentage for a score the judge did not produce; unmeasured is absent or 'n/a', never 0%.
Do not show a chat activity label the backend did not emit as a status node, and do not animate progress the backend did not report.
Do not restore a permanently lit 'Live' chip; a healthy transport reports nothing.
Do not add virtualization to MessageList without a measurement that justifies it.
revisit_if: The backend exposes per-turn token counts or TTFT that a reader (not an operator) can act on.
A non-admin role is introduced that legitimately needs retrieval scores.
A measured long thread regresses beyond the 200-message sanity check.
